scope: Reusable English 30-1 critical/analytical essay teaching; student assignment and literary text supplied by student

sources.title: English Language Arts 30-1 Guide for Students

outcomes.1.1.1: Form, test and refine tentative interpretations.
outcomes.2.1.2: Use close reading to relate controlling ideas, supporting details, characterization, tone and textual choices.
outcomes.2.2.2: Explain how craft, voice and recurring choices develop meaning.
outcomes.3.2.1: Record accurate information and sources, organize information and avoid plagiarism.
outcomes.4.1.2: Select purposeful forms and structures appropriate to the task.
outcomes.4.1.3: Develop a controlling focus with sufficient relevant support and ownership.
outcomes.4.2.1: Refine interpretation, reasoning, relevance and accuracy.
outcomes.4.2.2: Develop purposeful openings, relationships, unity and significant endings.
outcomes.4.2.3: Refine purposeful diction, syntax, transitions and voice.
outcomes.4.2.4: Check correctness and conventions in increasingly complex writing.

lessonMapping.title: Understand the task and choose a text

distinctions: Original teaching questions are not official scoring descriptors or automated grades.
Classroom assignment requirements take precedence for classroom work. Diploma expectations are explained separately.
Model texts are teaching examples, not recommended diploma studied texts.

originalModelProvenance.origin: Original fiction and teaching prose authored for this tool. No external literary passages copied.
